headline: Allcargo Global AGM concludes with all resolutions approved
summary: Allcargo Global Limited held its 3rd Annual General Meeting on September 22, 2026. Shareholders approved all eight resolutions, including financial statements adoption and borrowing limit increases.

headline: Manglam Infra wins Rs 0.96 Cr consultancy order from MPRRDA
summary: Manglam Infra & Engineering secured a Rs 0.96 crore consultancy order from MPRRDA for bridge projects. This adds to Q2FY27 inflows, though TTM revenue data is unavailable.

headline: Mayasheel wins Rs 38.23 Cr order from GNIDA
summary: Mayasheel Ventures secures Rs 38.23 crore work order from Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority for RCC drain construction. This significant contract bolsters the SME's order book, contrasting with prior quarter inflows.

headline: HUDCO promoter stake consolidated under MoHUA
summary: HUDCO discloses transfer of 20.73% promoter shares from Ministry of Rural Development to MoHUA. Total government holding remains 75%, with MoHUA now holding entire stake.

headline: Axiscades incorporates aerospace subsidiary
summary: Axiscades Technologies has incorporated a new subsidiary, Akkodis Axiscades Aerospace Engineering, to offer aerospace services.

headline: Prostarm Info Systems to launch 1.2 GWh BESS, UPS, lithium battery units
summary: Prostarm Info Systems plans to commence operations at its 1.2 GWh BESS, UPS, and lithium battery facilities from September 25.

headline: Orient Green Power commissions 17.6 MW solar plant
summary: Orient Green Power commissioned a 17.6 MW solar plant via subsidiary Delta, raising total capacity to 24.6 MW and fulfilling 2024 Rights Issue commitments.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Sugs Lloyd, Solex, Sapphire Foods in focus
summary: Sugs Lloyd rallies on a massive ₹213 crore order win, while Solex Energy eyes ₹4,500 crore revenue. Sapphire Foods faces a ₹516 crore GST notice.

headline: Apollo Micro clarifies EGM notice for preferential issue
summary: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd clarified observations on its EGM notice regarding a proposed preferential issue of 2.28 crore equity shares and 5.69 crore warrants, detailing allottee shareholding patterns.

headline: Prime Focus board approves $100 Mn Multiples investment
summary: Prime Focus Ltd board approved a $100 million investment by Multiples in subsidiaries BHL and Brahma India. This deal results in loss of control and change to associate status.

headline: Lords Mark targets April 2027 launch for AI breast cancer tech
summary: Lords Mark Industries advances AI-powered breast cancer screening to final clinical trials in US, UK, and Europe, targeting commercial launch by April 2027.

headline: SEBI plans to address derivatives settlement issues
summary: SEBI is planning to tackle issues related to derivatives settlement on expiry days, signalling a regulatory focus on improving market integrity and settlement processes.

symbol: ministry of mines, government of india
stock_name: ministry of mines, government of india
headline: Govt plans program to boost lithium, nickel processing
summary: The government plans a new program to enhance lithium and nickel processing, as reported by Mines Secretary Keshav Chandra, signalling a push to strengthen critical mineral value chains.

headline: Indraprastha Gas launches automated CNG cylinder check
summary: Indraprastha Gas has launched a new automated system to identify invalid and expired CNG cylinder certificates, strengthening safety compliance at its outlets.

headline: Mahindra expects Thar and Thar Roxx sales up 10%
summary: Mahindra & Mahindra expects Thar and Thar Roxx sales to rise at least 10% over the next year, with the original Thar projected to add about 60,000 units annually to SUV sales.

headline: Glenmark Pharma gets EIR from U.S. FDA for Goa facility
summary: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals has received an Establishment Inspection Report from the U.S. FDA for its Goa facility, with a Voluntary Action Indicated status.

headline: Oswal Pumps wins Rs 297.5 crore order from TREDCL
summary: Oswal Pumps secures Rs 297.5 crore confirmed order for solar rooftop projects in Telangana. Book-to-bill stands at 0.83x based on recent disclosures, with Q1FY27 revenue at Rs 481.70 crore.
